battle.name: 法國七月革命
battle.theater: 巴黎市區與卡魯塞爾廣場
battle.brief: 一八三〇年七月廿五日，查理十世頒布聖克盧敕令解散眾議院，廿七日巴黎街頭築起數千座路障，廿九日杜樂麗宮與市政廳相繼失守，王室退往聖克盧。馬爾蒙元帥以一萬一千五百人與十二門以上近衛軍野砲封鎖路口，最後在協和廣場收兵退出。野砲在三日之內既用來對付路障，也被起義者奪去反轉過來。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 交戰的兩方是法蘭西王國的波旁復辟朝廷與巴黎的起義者。朝廷一方以查理十世為國王，但指揮權落在大臣與巴黎駐軍指揮官手中：掌璽大臣波利尼亞克親王與內政大臣敘爾茲伯爵掌政，巴黎方面由陸軍元帥拉古薩公爵馬爾蒙全權指揮，可用兵力一萬一千五百人，其中被視為可靠的王家近衛軍（包含一個瑞士團）約五千五百人，其餘是未經對付本國人群的一線步兵，另有若干警察與稅吏武裝。起義一方沒有建制軍隊，實際由三類人組成：早於一八二七年被解散但未繳械的巴黎國民自衛軍、被解散後流散街頭的軍人與工匠武裝、以及大批持獵槍與手工武器的市民；此外還有在巴黎的軍官學校學員與工科大學學生，以及外省趕來的共和派。巴黎以外，國王在聖克盧坐鎮，凡爾賽與外省部隊奉命進京但遲滯不前，馬爾蒙也未能及時從聖但尼、旺塞訥、呂內維爾等地調兵。革命成功後，奧爾良公爵路易－腓力被推為法國人的國王，建立七月王朝。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Bourbon Restoration court of the Kingdom of France and the insurgents of Paris. On the side of the court, Charles X was king, but command lay with the ministers and with the commander of the Paris garrison: the Minister of the Royal Household, Prince de Polignac, and the Minister of the Interior, Count de Martignac, directed policy, while in Paris the Marshal Duke of Ragusa, Marmont, held full authority over a force of eleven thousand five hundred men, of whom the Royal Guard, including one Swiss regiment, numbering about five thousand five hundred, was considered reliable, the remainder being line infantry unused to firing on the population of its own country, supplemented by police and revenue officers armed for duty. The insurgents had no formed army; they were in fact three kinds of men: the Paris National Guard, disbanded in 1827 but never disarmed, former soldiers and artisan bands scattered after the disbandment, and a large number of citizens with hunting guns and improvised weapons; to these were added the cadets of the military schools and the students of the École Polytechnique resident in Paris, and republicans arriving from the provinces. Outside Paris the king sat at Saint-Cloud, and the Versailles and provincial troops ordered up to the capital moved slowly; Marmont was equally unable to bring up troops in time from Saint-Denis, Vincennes, Lunéville and Saint-Omer. After the revolution succeeded, the Duke of Orléans, Louis-Philippe, was put forward as King of the French and the July Monarchy was established.
people: 查理十世是這場衝突的起點與失敗的根源：一八三〇年七月廿五日在聖克盧頒布四道敕令，解散新選出的眾議院、限制出版、改變選舉資格，等於用一次憲法政變壓制自由派議會。他本人退居聖克盧，把局面交給大臣與馬爾蒙，此後再未到巴黎。馬爾蒙元帥是關鍵人物：他在一八一四年開城向拿破崙投降，聲譽本已不佳，此次奉命鎮壓又綽綽有餘，卻下達不先開火、避免屠殺的命令，使王軍在起義者面前失去主動。他的部署把兵力與砲火分散到各主要路口：近衛第一步兵團在卡普辛大道配兩門砲，近衛第三步兵團在卡魯塞爾配四門砲、一百五十名槍騎兵與精騎警察，瑞士團（近衛第七團）在路易十五廣場配六門砲，第十五輕步兵團在新橋，第五線列步兵團在旺多姆廣場。巴黎方面，國民自衛軍元帥拉法耶特在最後一天出面維持秩序；自由派議員拉菲特、佩里埃、莫通等人組成反對派委員會求見國王被拒，首相朱爾親王連接見也不肯；共和派記者阿爾芒·卡雷爾在《國民報》號召報紙繼續出版並主張抵抗；工科大學學員沙拉斯等人組成隊伍，於二十九日清晨在先賢祠一帶集結，先攻下瑞士營房，再由南岸推進杜樂麗宮。三十日奧爾良公爵抵達市政廈；九月制憲議會以一八三〇年憲章確認新體制，路易－腓力於八月九日被確認為法國人的國王。
peopleEn: Charles X was both the origin of the conflict and the root of its failure: on 25 July 1830, at Saint-Cloud, he issued four ordinances dissolving the newly elected Chamber of Deputies, restricting the press and altering the electoral qualification, which amounted to a constitutional coup against the liberal deputies. He himself withdrew to Saint-Cloud and left the situation to his ministers and to Marmont, and never came back to Paris. Marshal Marmont was the decisive figure. He had opened the gates to Napoleon in 1814 and his reputation was already damaged; now ordered to suppress the rising, he had troops to spare, yet he gave instructions not to fire first and to avoid a massacre, and the royal troops therefore lost the initiative against the insurgents. His dispositions scattered both the infantry and the guns across the principal crossings: the 1st Guard infantry with two guns on the boulevard des Capucines, the 3rd Guard with four guns, a hundred and fifty lancers and the gendarmerie d'élite at the Carrousel, the Swiss regiment, the 7th of the Guard, with six guns on the place Louis XV, the 15th light infantry at the Pont-Neuf, and the 5th line infantry on the place Vendôme. On the Paris side the National Guard commander Lafayette appeared on the last day to keep order; the liberal deputies Lafitte, Périer, Mouton and others formed a committee of opposition and were refused an audience with the king, the prime minister Prince Jules not even seeing them; the republican journalist Armand Carrel called in Le National for the papers to continue publishing and for resistance; a column of École Polytechnique cadets, among them Charras, formed near the Panthéon on the morning of the 29th, stormed the Swiss barracks and then drove on the Tuileries from the left bank. On the 30th the Duke of Orléans reached the Hôtel de Ville; in September the constituent assembly confirmed the new order with the Charter of 1830, Louis-Philippe having been recognised as King of the French on 9 August.
kits: 野砲在三日之內既是王朝的工具，也是它的短板。朝廷在巴黎街頭的火力骨架，是王家近衛軍各團隨步兵分帶的營屬野砲：近衛第一團在卡普辛大道配兩門，第三團在卡魯塞爾配四門並有精騎警察與一百五十名槍騎兵配合，瑞士團在路易十五廣場配六門，線列步兵團也各自攜帶團屬砲。數量有限而部署分散，火砲無法在任何一個街口形成壓倒性的火力；一旦街道被路障切斷、視線被樓房遮斷，砲口只能對著看不見的目標，馬爾蒙事後也承認這一部署既未考慮周全也超出實際可用兵力。起義一方的火力來源則是零散的獵槍、手槍與少數被奪取的舊式火槍，火藥與彈藥靠民間搜羅與被繳械的國民自衛軍倉庫；他們沒有成建制的炮兵，卻有另一種優勢，即熟悉街巷、可在夜間與建築物之間轉移，使王軍的砲火難以追蹤。街道器材同樣被當作武器：鋪路石、屋瓦、窗台花盆與翻覆的公共馬車都成了攻擊守軍的投擲物與障礙，廿七日入夜時全城已築起四千多座路障。三日之後可清點的殘餘留在巴黎市內：王軍在協和廣場重新集結時已損失數門砲，一八三〇年七月廿九日在紐利堡公園射出的最後一發砲彈，後來被鑲在紀念碑的浮雕上留在城堡入口上方。
kitsEn: The field gun was during those three days both the instrument of the dynasty and its weakness. The skeleton of the royal firepower in the streets of Paris consisted of the battery pieces carried by the Royal Guard infantry with their units: the 1st Guard with two guns on the boulevard des Capucines, the 3rd Guard with four guns at the Carrousel supported by the gendarmerie d'élite and a hundred and fifty lancers, the Swiss regiment with six guns on the place Louis XV, the line regiments each bringing their own brigade guns. The numbers were few and the dispositions dispersed, so that the guns could never concentrate a decisive fire on any single crossing; once the streets were cut by barricades and the sight lines blocked by houses, the muzzles could only be pointed at targets they could not see, and Marmont afterwards admitted that the plan had been ill considered and exceeded the troops actually available. The firepower of the insurgents was scattered hunting guns, pistols and a few captured old muskets, with powder and shot picked up from civilian sources and from the stores of the disarmed National Guard; they had no formed artillery, but they had a different advantage, knowing the lanes and being able to shift between the buildings at night, which made the royal fire hard to follow. Street materials served as weapons in their own right: paving stones, roof tiles, window-boxes and overturned omnibuses were used as missiles and as obstructions, and by the night of the 27th more than four thousand barricades stood across the city. After the three days the remnants could be counted in the streets of Paris: the royal troops had already lost several guns when they re-formed at the Place de la Concorde, and the last round fired by the royal artillery, on 29 July 1830 in the park of the Château de Neuilly, was later set in the relief of a monument above the entrance to the castle.
tactics: 雙方的戰術都是城市戰。朝廷一方的辦法是控制路口、架設野砲，以直射砲火與騎兵衝鋒掃清路障：近衛軍各團被分派到卡魯塞爾廣場、卡普辛大道、路易十五廣場、旺多姆廣場與新橋等要點，每團配置二至六門砲，騎兵與精騎警察負責街道清障。起義一方的辦法是先奪火器再築路障：廿七日白天被稱為石頭日，人們在警察查封報社的消息傳開後湧上街頭，用鋪路石、屋瓦與花盆砸向士兵，到夜間已能從國民自衛軍倉庫和軍械店取得獵槍與舊式火槍，一夜之間全城豎起四千多座路障，缺口只留給步槍與近迫射擊使用，砲火因此難以直接命中。廿八日，聖安托萬區一帶有王家近衛騎兵的衝鋒與街道群眾的對峙，聖但尼斯門與巴士底一線反覆爭奪，路埃什街與聖奧諾雷街轉角那座用翻覆的公共馬車與運水車築成的障礙，馬爾蒙曾派一名副官帶十五名步兵去拆除。廿九日清晨，工科大學學員與共和派學生在先賢祠附近集結，先攻下瑞士營房，再由南岸推進杜樂麗宮，使王軍在卡魯塞爾與羅浮宮之間被切斷；同日午後市政廳被占領。整個三日裡，砲與路障的對峙決定了誰能控制街口：誰能把砲推到對方路障前、誰能守住通往市政廳的通道，誰就控制局面。最後王軍在協和廣場重新集結，退往城外，並在紐利堡與塞納河各橋一線持續轟擊。
tacticsEn: The tactics of both sides were those of urban fighting. The court's method was to hold the crossings, to plant field guns, and to clear the barricades with direct fire and cavalry charges: the Guard regiments were posted to the Carrousel, the boulevard des Capucines, the place Louis XV, the place Vendôme and the Pont-Neuf, each with two to six guns, the lancers and the gendarmerie d'élite clearing the streets. The method of the insurgents was to seize weapons first and build barricades afterwards: on the 27th, a day remembered as the day of the stones, the news that the police had seized the presses sent crowds into the streets, where paving stones, roof tiles and flowerpots were thrown at the soldiers; by night they had taken hunting guns and old muskets from the stores of the National Guard and from the armourers' shops, and in a single night more than four thousand barricades rose across the city, their gaps left open for muskets and close shooting, so that artillery fire could no longer strike them directly. On the 28th there was the clash of the Guard cavalry with the crowds in the faubourg Saint-Antoine, and repeated fighting at the Porte Saint-Denis and the line of the Bastille; the obstruction at the corner of the rue de l'Échelle and the rue Saint-Honoré, built of an overturned omnibus and a water cart, was one for which Marmont sent an aide-de-camp with fifteen infantry to clear it. On the morning of the 29th the Polytechnique cadets and the republican students formed near the Panthéon, stormed the Swiss barracks and drove on the Tuileries from the left bank, cutting the royal troops off between the Carrousel and the Louvre; the Hôtel de Ville was taken in the same afternoon. Through the three days the duel between guns and barricades decided who held the crossings: whoever could bring a gun up to the enemy's barricade, and whoever could keep the road to the Hôtel de Ville open, controlled the situation. In the end the royal troops re-formed at the Place de la Concorde and withdrew beyond the barriers, firing in retreat across Neuilly and along the bridges over the Seine.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。衝突自一八三〇年七月廿七日入夜起，至二十九日下午市政廳易手、王軍退往城外為止，共三日。朝廷可用兵力一萬一千五百人，其中王家近衛軍約五千五百人；起義一方的規模在二萬至三萬人之間，另有數千名武裝工人與學生參與。全城在一夜之間築起四千多座路障。朝廷近衛軍的野砲部署包括近衛第一團兩門、近衛第三團四門、瑞士團六門，合計十二門以上，另有線列步兵團的團屬砲分列巴黎各處。七月廿七日夜警察查封《國民報》等報社，廿八日聖安托萬區與聖但尼斯門一線交火，廿九日凌晨瑞士營房被工科大學學員攻破，同日下午一時三十分杜樂麗宮被攻破，羅浮宮與市政廳在當日午後相繼失守。朝廷方面的損失，據當時與後來的軍史統計，約有一百六十三人陣亡、五百七十八人受傷。七月三十日國王出逃，凡爾賽宮與巴黎的聯繫切斷；八月二日查理十世與昂古萊姆公爵放棄王位繼承權並流亡，八月九日路易－腓力被確認為法國人的國王，九月國民議會通過一八三〇年憲章。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. The fighting ran from the night of 27 July 1830 until the afternoon of the 29th, when the Hôtel de Ville changed hands and the royal troops withdrew beyond the barriers, three days in all. The court had eleven thousand five hundred men available, of whom about five thousand five hundred belonged to the Royal Guard; the insurgents are put at between twenty and thirty thousand, with several thousand armed workers and students taking part. More than four thousand barricades went up across the city in a single night. The royal field gun deployment included two guns with the 1st Guard, four with the 3rd Guard and six with the Swiss, twelve or more in all, with the brigade guns of the line regiments posted at various points in the city. On the night of the 27th the police seized the presses of Le National and the other papers; on the 28th there was fighting in the faubourg Saint-Antoine and at the Porte Saint-Denis; on the morning of the 29th the Swiss barracks were stormed by the Polytechnique cadets, and in the afternoon of the same day the Tuileries were taken at half past one, the Louvre and the Hôtel de Ville following in the course of the afternoon. The royal losses, according to the military history written at the time and afterwards, were about a hundred and sixty-three men killed and five hundred and seventy-eight wounded. On 30 July the king fled and the link between Versailles and Paris was cut; on 2 August Charles X and the Duke of Angoulême renounced their rights to the throne and left the country; on 9 August Louis-Philippe was recognised as King of the French; and in September the National Assembly passed the Charter of 1830.
cause: 起因是復辟王朝把政治權與經濟負擔同時壓到自由派身上。查理十世清洗軍中曾為拿破崙效力的軍官，恢復土地貴族權力，以賠償六十五萬法郎的名義補償革命時期受損的舊貴族，把國債利息由百分之五降至百分之三；一八二六年實施出版法、加重罰款與檢舉制度；宗教方面重推天主教會，一八二四年主教獲授權委派小學教員，到一八三〇年巴黎約三分之一的小學哲學教師是教士；對外政策上介入希臘獨立、遠征阿爾及利亞都未見成果，國民耐心耗盡。關鍵的一擊是七月廿五日以聖克盧敕令為名的憲法政變：解散新選出的眾議院、改變選舉法，使九月大選中原本四分之三合資格選民失去投票資格。這等於向資產階級直接挑戰，交易所停止借貸，店主與工廠主關門，工人因失業湧上街頭，廿七日警察搜查報社成為引爆點，衝突從騷亂升級為革命，馬爾蒙當天寫給國王的字條用的正是這個判斷。外部原因是維也納體系在西班牙與意大利留下的壓力，以及同年比利時革命成功的刺激。
causeEn: The cause was the way the Restoration pressed political power and economic burden onto the liberals at the same time. Charles X purged the officers who had served Napoleon, restored the power of the landed nobility, compensated the old nobility for losses in the Revolution to the tune of six hundred and fifty thousand francs, and cut the interest on the national debt from five per cent to three; in 1826 the press law imposed heavier fines and denunciation; in religious matters the Church was promoted, and in 1824 the bishops were given the right to appoint the primary school teachers, so that by 1830 about a third of the philosophy teachers in the Paris schools were clerics; and in foreign policy the intervention in Greek independence and the expedition to Algeria brought no visible success, so that patience ran out. The decisive blow was the constitutional coup of 25 July, disguised as the ordinances of Saint-Cloud: dissolving the newly elected Chamber of Deputies and altering the electoral law, so that in the September elections about three quarters of those previously entitled to vote would lose the franchise. This was a direct challenge to the propertied classes; the exchange stopped discounting, shopkeepers and factory owners closed, and the unemployed workers poured into the streets, and the police search of the press on the 27th was the spark that turned a riot into a revolution, as Marmont's note to the king that same day put it. The external causes were the pressure left by the Vienna settlement in Spain and Italy, and the stimulus of the successful Belgian revolution of the same year.
impact: 三日之戰改變了法國的國體與歐洲的局勢。查理十世退位、波旁主支斷絕，奧爾良支入主並頒布一八三〇年憲章：選民年齡由三十降到二十五，財產門檻由三百法郎降到二百五十法郎，議員年齡上限由四十降到三十，出版審查廢除，天主教法令被取消，並開始在每個市鎮設立國家資助的小學。白旗被三色旗取代，七月王朝把君主置於議會與責任內閣之下，國王以法國人的國王而非法國的國王自居。國際層面上，法國主動退出了梅特涅主導的歐洲協調，與保守體系分道揚鑣，比利時的獨立隨即得到推進，德意志諸邦的革命與波蘭的十一月起義也被鼓動，維也納會議後被壓制的自由主義與民族主義第一次在歐洲中心取得政權。軍事上，三日之戰顯示常備軍在缺乏政治意志時無法對付城市民眾，也顯示砲兵在路障面前射程受限，後者促使各國重新計算城防與民防的關係；而巴黎國民自衛軍的重新武裝，又讓國家武裝成為此後一八三〇年代政治論爭的核心。兩年之後的六月起義與一八四八年的二月革命，都以對這場三日成果的不滿為起點。
impactEn: The three days changed the form of the French state and the situation of Europe. Charles X abdicated, the main Bourbon line ended, the Orleans branch took the throne and issued the Charter of 1830: the age of the franchise fell from thirty to twenty-five, the property qualification from three hundred to two hundred and fifty francs, the maximum age of deputies from forty to thirty, the censorship of the press was abolished, the religious ordinances of the Restoration were cancelled, and a state-funded school was begun in every commune. The white flag was replaced by the tricolour, and the July Monarchy placed the sovereign under parliament and a responsible ministry, the king calling himself King of the French rather than King of France. At the international level France voluntarily left the European concert led by Metternich and broke with the conservative order; Belgian independence was carried forward, the revolutions in the German states and the Polish November Uprising were encouraged, and the liberalism and nationalism that the Congress of Vienna had suppressed obtained power for the first time in the centre of Europe. Militarily the three days showed that a standing army cannot be used against a city population when it lacks the political will to do so, and also that the range of artillery is curtailed by barricades, which led the powers to reconsider the relation between fortification and the defence of towns; and the rearming of the Paris National Guard made the question of a national armed force the core of political argument in the 1830s. The June insurrection of 1832 and the February revolution of 1848 both began from discontent with what these three days had produced.
result: 結果是王室的失敗與新王朝的建立。廿七日入夜起戰，至廿九日下午市政廳被占領，杜樂麗宮與羅浮宮在當日相繼失守，國王退往聖克盧；馬爾蒙在協和廣場重新集結殘部，組織退往城外，三十日在紐利堡一線以砲火掩護撤退，隨後解除了對巴黎的封鎖。廿七、廿八兩夜，巴黎的砲聲與槍聲成為全城聽聞的聲音，到三十日王室已無可用手段。八月二日，查理十世與昂古萊姆公爵放棄王位繼承權並離開法國；最初的方案是讓波爾多公爵以亨利五世即位，但自由派議員選擇了奧爾良公爵，路易－腓力於八月九日被確認為國王，九月的制憲議會以一八三〇年憲章確認新體制。軍隊的結果同樣明確：王家近衛軍被解散，瑞士團被解除武裝並隨王室流亡，巴黎國民自衛軍重新武裝並被納入新王朝的秩序，警察、司法與出版制度全部改組。三日之戰沒有留下戰場上的勝負判定，但留下了延續近二十年的政體：國王由波旁主支換成奧爾良支，三色旗取代白旗，審查制度與舊貴族的補償被廢除，議會成為真正的主權來源之一；而同一套安排在隨後的巴黎共和派眼中被視為對起義者的背叛，構成了下一次革命的理由。
resultEn: The result was the defeat of the court and the establishment of a new dynasty. Fighting began on the night of the 27th; by the afternoon of the 29th the Hôtel de Ville had been taken, the Tuileries and the Louvre had fallen in the course of the day, and the king had withdrawn to Saint-Cloud. Marmont re-formed the remnants at the Place de la Concorde, organised the retreat beyond the barriers, covered it with gunfire at Neuilly on the 30th and then lifted the blockade of Paris. On the nights of the 27th and the 28th the sound of the guns and muskets in Paris was heard throughout the city, and by the 30th the court had no means left. On 2 August Charles X and the Duke of Angoulême renounced their rights to the throne and left France; the first plan was for the Duke of Bordeaux to reign as Henry V, but the liberal deputies chose the Duke of Orléans, Louis-Philippe was recognised as king on 9 August, and the constituent assembly confirmed the new order with the Charter of 1830 in September. The fate of the troops was no less clear: the Royal Guard was disbanded, the Swiss regiment was disarmed and left with the royal family, the Paris National Guard was rearmed and drawn into the order of the new dynasty, and the police, the courts and the press system were all reorganised. The three days left no verdict on the field of battle, but they left a regime that would run for nearly twenty years: the main Bourbon line replaced by the Orleans branch, the tricolour in place of the white flag, the censorship and the compensation of the old nobility abolished, and parliament established as a genuine source of sovereignty; and the same settlement, seen by the Paris republicans as a betrayal of the insurgents, became the ground of the next revolution.
